context: Hiroshi-boss and Yuki design a company-wide policy.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business strategy; abstract vocabulary (総合/一体/さまざま/多数/有効) in natural home.

lines.jp: さまざまな部署を、一体にしたい。
lines.en: I want to unite the various departments.
lines.style: composed boss voice, soft warm authoritative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 総合的な方針が、必要ですね。

lines.speaker: yuki_office

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
